class.name: ResonanceServer
class.brief_description: Singleton managing Steam Audio context, scene, and simulation. Driven by ResonanceRuntime.
class.description: ResonanceServer is the low-level Steam Audio engine. Typically accessed via [ResonanceRuntime] and [ResonancePlayer]. Use get_singleton() for advanced scripting. Controls listener position, geometry, probe batches, and simulation tick. Debug flags (debug_occlusion, debug_reflections, debug_pathing) enable ray visualization; output_direct and output_reverb gate direct/reverb output for debugging.

method.name: get_ambisonic_order
method.description: Returns the active ambisonics order (1–3) used for simulation and reverb decode.

method.name: get_default_reflections_mode
method.description: Returns the runtime default reflections mode for players using [i]Use Global[/i]: [code]0[/code] = Baked, [code]1[/code] = Realtime (see [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.default_reflections_mode]). Values [code]2[/code] and above from older configs are treated as Realtime.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the current sample rate from AudioServer.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns Nexus Resonance version string.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns true if the Steam Audio engine is initialized.

method.name: is_simulating
method.description: Returns true when the server can run acoustic simulation: static triangle count > 0 for normal tracers, or [code]scene_type[/code] Custom with a valid [World3D] from [method set_physics_world].

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Ordered teardown of Steam Audio (worker join, drain audio-thread IPL clients under [AudioServer] lock, then release simulator/scene/context). Idempotent. [ResonanceRuntime] calls this from [code]_exit_tree[/code] before the FMOD bridge; the GDExtension terminator also invokes it. Use when quitting the game to avoid use-after-free on the audio mix thread.

method.name: notify_geometry_changed
method.description: Notifies the server of geometry change (triangle count delta). Called when dynamic geometry is added/removed.

method.name: refresh_all_geometry_from_scene_tree
method.description: Traverses the active scene tree and calls [method ResonanceGeometry.refresh_geometry] on every [ResonanceGeometry] node. Call from the main thread after [method load_scene_data] replaces the Phonon scene (the server also schedules this automatically when a load succeeds). Rebuilds [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] instanced meshes and static runtime handles so occlusion, reflections, and pathing see the new scene.

method.name: load_scene_data
method.description: Loads serialized Steam Audio scene data from disk into the runtime scene. On success, defers [method refresh_all_geometry_from_scene_tree] so [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] and other geometry nodes re-register against the new IPL scene.

method.name: save_scene_data
method.description: Saves the current Steam Audio scene to a serialized file ([code]IPL_SCENETYPE_DEFAULT[/code] only; see Steam Audio docs).

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances simulation (pathing, reflections). Called each frame by ResonanceRuntime. When [code]scene_type[/code] is Custom, runs Steam Audio [code]iplSimulatorRun*[/code] on the main thread (no background worker).

method.name: set_physics_world
method.description: Sets the Godot [World3D] for Custom-scene physics raycasts. [ResonanceRuntime] updates this from the viewport each frame when the server is initialized.

method.name: set_physics_ray_exclude_rids
method.description: User list of [RID]s excluded from Custom-scene ray queries (same as [code]PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.exclude[/code]). The server merges this with [method set_listener_physics_ray_exclude_rids] and auto-registered source colliders from [member ResonancePlayer.auto_exclude_colliders] before passing the combined array to Godot.

method.name: set_listener_physics_ray_exclude_rids
method.description: Replaces the listener-side exclude list (typically [code]CollisionObject3D[/code] RIDs on the camera parent chain and nodes in the [code]resonance_listener[/code] group). [ResonanceRuntime] sets this each frame when [method uses_custom_ray_tracer] is true. Merged with [method set_physics_ray_exclude_rids] and source auto-excludes.

method.name: get_simulation_worker_timing
method.description: Returns profiling timings from the [b]last[/b] simulation step only (microseconds): [code]us_run_direct[/code], [code]us_run_reflections[/code], [code]us_run_pathing[/code], [code]us_sync_fetch[/code] ([code]_worker_sync_fetch_caches[/code]), [code]us_simulator_commit[/code] ([code]iplSimulatorCommit[/code], required after [code]SetSharedInputs[/code] per Steam Audio). Breakdown inside sync (last tick only): [code]us_sync_fetch_occlusion[/code], [code]us_sync_fetch_reflections[/code], [code]us_sync_fetch_pathing[/code] (subset of [code]us_sync_fetch[/code]; zero when that phase did not run or was skipped). Normally updated from the background worker; when [code]scene_type[/code] is Custom, updated from the main-thread [method tick] instead. Large [code]us_run_reflections[/code] with small sync/commit usually indicates cost inside the Phonon library, not this wrapper. Cleared by [method reset_pathing_instrumentation].

method.name: peek_reverb_params_likely_available
method.description: Returns whether the last worker reflection cache sync (or a successful [code]fetch_reverb_params[/code] with [code]simulation_mutex[/code]) had usable reflection outputs for this source handle. Does [i]not[/i] acquire [code]simulation_mutex[/code] or call Steam Audio — cheap for main-thread state (e.g. [code]has_valid_reverb[/code] in [code]ResonancePlayer[/code]). May be [code]false[/code] briefly after source creation until the next sync; call [code]fetch_reverb_params[/code] when full [code]IPLReflectionEffectParams[/code] are required.

method.name: get_convolution_audio_timing
method.description: [b]Convolution reflection type only[/b] (audio mix thread): last measured block times in microseconds — [code]us_reflection_apply_last[/code] ([code]iplReflectionEffectApply[/code] feeding the shared mixer from the most recent [code]ResonancePlayer[/code] path that ran it), [code]us_reverb_bus_last[/code] ([code]iplReflectionMixerApply[/code] plus ambisonic decode and output sanitize in [code]ResonanceAudioEffect[/code] / [code]ResonanceMixerProcessor[/code]). Subset of the reverb-bus path (last block only): [code]us_mixer_sanitize_ambi_last[/code] and [code]us_mixer_sanitize_stereo_last[/code] are the two [code]_sanitize_audio_buffer[/code] passes on ambisonic mixer output vs. stereo after decode (compare at high ambisonic order). Compare to [method get_simulation_worker_timing] ([code]us_run_reflections[/code]) to separate Phonon simulation work from per-block convolution on the audio thread. With multiple wet sources, [code]us_reflection_apply_last[/code] reflects the [i]last[/i] source that mixed in that window, not a sum. Cleared to zero by [method reset_reverb_bus_instrumentation].

method.name: get_simulation_tracer_profile
method.description: For profiling and setup checks: [code]scene_type[/code] (runtime config 0–3), [code]ipl_scene_type[/code] (Steam Audio enum), [code]ray_batch_size_effective[/code] passed to [code]IPLSimulationSettings.rayBatchSize[/code] (Custom: clamped [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.physics_ray_batch_size]; otherwise [code]1[/code]). [code]custom_batched_callbacks_registered[/code] and [code]phonon_batched_reflection_sim_path[/code] are [code]true[/code] only when Custom and effective batch [code]> 1[/code] (batched Godot trace callbacks; Phonon BatchedReflectionSimulator). Default/Embree/Radeon keep batch [code]1[/code] from Nexus regardless of the config property.

method.name: set_listener_valid
method.description: Set whether the listener is valid for pathing. When false, RunPathing is skipped (saves CPU). On Windows, iplSimulatorRunPathing is wrapped in SEH—crashes from unreachable listener (ghost through walls, noclip) are caught; pathing skips that frame and continues.

method.name: update_listener
method.description: Updates listener position and orientation. Called by ResonanceListener or ResonanceRuntime fallback.

Enable pathing segment visualization (green = unoccluded, red = occluded).
Enable direct sound output. For debugging; normally true via config.

When true, the convolution reverb bus applies a short linear ramp when wet peak collapses in one callback (Godot scheduling edge). Disable for A/B wet-tail tests; see [method get_reverb_bus_instrumentation] key [code]effect_click_guard_triggers[/code].
